verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no asynchronous batch-job API and no discounted batch rate. The pricing page lists a single per-input-token price ($0.042/Mtok) with no batch tier. The AsyncTypeSafeClient only makes ordinary non-blocking real-time requests. The "12.2x cheaper" cookbook claim comes from packing many questions into one synchronous call, which is a usage pattern rather than a discounted batch-job rate.
